description: Use this when the host asks which interviews they have, wants to find one by its title, or when another tool needs an interview's id. Do not use it for meetings held on another service, for another account's interviews or to read what participants said: it lists interviews only. It returns the host's interviews, most recently changed first, with how many people are on each, how many finished, and whether the public link is on. An audio interview, where the participant needs only a microphone, is marked Audio; a video one is not marked. It has no search or date filter, so find the interview the host means by its title in the list.
name: list_interviews
title: List interviews
